title: Infinity Emoji ♾️ Meaning: Forever, Limitless, and More
description: The ♾️ infinity emoji means forever, endless, or without limits. See how it is used for love, friendship, math, and as a symbol of neurodiversity.
summary: The ♾️ infinity emoji is the sideways figure eight from mathematics. It means forever, endless, or unlimited, and is used for lasting love and friendship, boundless amounts, and loops that never finish. It is also a recognized symbol of neurodiversity and autism acceptance.
meaning: ♾️ carries the mathematical idea of something without end into everyday talk. In romantic and family messages it means always: "you and me ♾️" is a promise that the bond is permanent. It has the same sentiment as infinity jewelry and tattoos, and it is a frequent choice for anniversaries, wedding captions, and tributes to someone who has died.

It also expresses quantity. "Thanks ♾️," "♾️ respect," and "I have ♾️ tabs open" all use it as an exaggerated number, bigger than 💯. Brands use it for unlimited plans, refills, or replay value. In these cases the emoji works like the word "infinite" dropped into the sentence, and nobody takes the claim literally; it is friendly overstatement.

The symbol itself, called a lemniscate, was introduced as a mathematical sign for infinity by the English mathematician John Wallis in 1655. Students and science communicators use the emoji literally for limits, set theory, and jokes about dividing by zero. It reached emoji keyboards relatively late, in 2018, which is why older phones may not show it.

One specific cultural use deserves knowing. A rainbow infinity loop represents neurodiversity, and a gold one is used for autism in particular; many autistic people prefer these to the older puzzle-piece imagery. Since there is no colored variant, ♾️ in a bio often signals that the person is neurodivergent or an ally.

contexts.label: From a crush or partner
contexts.body: Sent with a heart or initials, ♾️ says the feeling has no expiry date. Couples put it between their names or next to an anniversary date in bios. Early in dating it is a big statement, so when it comes from someone you have just met it is more likely enthusiasm than a considered vow.

contexts.label: In bios and identity
contexts.body: A standalone ♾️ in a profile frequently refers to neurodiversity or autism pride, sometimes beside 🌈. It may also point to a best-friend pact, a faith in eternal life, or simply a favorite symbol. Other details in the bio usually make clear which is meant.

contexts.label: In texting
contexts.body: Day to day it amplifies: endless gratitude, endless patience needed, an endless queue. It also describes loops, like a show you keep rewatching. Friends close their messages with it the way they might write "always" or "forever" at the end of a card.

examples.text: Ten years with my favorite person ♾️❤️
examples.meaning: An anniversary message promising the relationship will last.
The friendship is permanent in the sender's eyes.

examples.text: My to-do list is ♾️ this week
examples.meaning: A complaint that the workload feels never-ending.
The emoji is used as the neurodiversity symbol in a statement of identity.
A playful twist on a famous movie catchphrase to express huge affection.

combos.meaning: Endless love; a relationship meant to last forever.
Neurodiversity pride, echoing the rainbow infinity symbol.
Remembering someone who has died; loved forever.

confusedWith.difference: 🔄 means refresh, repeat, or swap, a cycle you run through and can stop. ♾️ means something has no end at all. "Again" is 🔄; "always" is ♾️.
💯 expresses complete agreement or full effort, a perfect score. ♾️ goes past any score to mean limitless. They are sometimes stacked, but 💯 is about quality and ♾️ about duration or amount.
➿ is two small loops side by side, a Japanese voicemail symbol. It can resemble a narrow infinity sign in some fonts, yet it has no connection to endlessness and is rarely used outside Japan.

avoid: Do not send ♾️ to a new romantic interest unless you are comfortable with it reading as "forever."
Avoid using it mockingly around neurodiversity topics, given that many people treat it as an identity symbol.
Do not use it for unlimited offers in marketing if the offer in fact has limits.
design: A horizontal figure eight, the standard infinity sign. Depending on the platform it appears as a dark symbol on its own or as a white symbol on a colored square tile. All versions use a smooth, even loop without decoration. No rainbow or gold variant exists in the emoji set, although those colors matter in neurodiversity and autism symbolism.

faqs.q: What does ♾️ mean from a girl or a guy?
faqs.a: In a romantic context it means they see the connection as lasting, a way of saying forever or always. Between friends it marks a lifelong bond. If it follows a number or thing, they are just exaggerating an amount.

faqs.q: What does ♾️ mean in someone's bio?
faqs.a: Commonly that the person is autistic or otherwise neurodivergent, or supports neurodiversity. It can also sit between a couple's names or initials to signal commitment. Check for nearby hints such as a rainbow, a date, or another person's handle.

faqs.q: Why is infinity a symbol for autism?
faqs.a: The loop represents a spectrum with endless variation rather than a problem to be solved. Advocates adopted a rainbow infinity for neurodiversity generally and a gold one for autism, as alternatives to the puzzle piece, which many autistic people dislike.

It became an emoji in 2018 as part of Emoji 11.0. The mathematical character it is based on existed in Unicode long before, which is why a plain text infinity sign, ∞, also works on almost every device.
